xtmux-cku.description:
Hit on xtmux #59 (2026-07-22). #59 was stacked on #58's branch xt/wave-8b-xtmux. Squash-merging #58 deleted that branch; GitHub auto-closed #59.

Every repair path is refused:
- gh pr edit 59 --base main -> GraphQL projects-classic deprecation error
- REST PATCH state=open -> 422 'state cannot be changed. The <head> branch was force-pushed or recreated'
- Recreating the base ref then reopening -> same 422. Permanent, not retryable.

Recovery is only: open a NEW PR from the same head, cross-link, lose the review-thread continuity on the old one. Done as #61.

Doctrine fix for the multiplexing/stacked-PR flow: retarget a stacked PR to main BEFORE its parent merges, not after. Marking the child draft (which we did) keeps it out of the merge queue but gives zero protection against base-branch deletion.

Secondary: with the child's review history stranded on a closed PR, a re-review of the replacement can resurface findings already answered — #61 immediately drew a fresh P1 that partly restated known context.
xtmux-cku.title: Stacked PRs are auto-closed unrecoverably when their base branch is squash-merged
